title: Name a repeated policy literal
why: A repeated threshold, duration, or capacity literal can drift because its purpose is not named.
suggestion: Define one purpose-named constant near the behavior that owns this policy.
limitations: Candidates are compared only across sibling source files; Python comment text, generic min/max calls, collection length comparisons, bare `count` identifiers, common integer sentinels and unit conversions, and digits embedded in identifier or numeric type names are excluded.
